description: Source code for the Fls (flash driver) module implementing flash memory operations such as init, erase, write, read, and status management, with support for AUTOSAR standards and specific hardware interactions on MPC55xx architecture.

methods.name: Fls_Init
methods.description: Initializes the flash driver with configuration parameters.

methods.name: Fls_Erase
methods.description: Erases specified flash sectors at given address and length.

methods.name: Fls_Write
methods.description: Programs data into flash memory at specified address.

methods.name: Fls_Read
methods.description: Reads data from flash memory at specified address.

methods.name: Fls_Compare
methods.description: Compares flash memory content with provided data.

methods.name: Fls_SetMode
methods.description: Sets the operational mode (fast or slow) for flash operations.

methods.name: Fls_GetVersionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves version information of the module.

methods.name: Fls_GetStatus
methods.description: Returns current status of the flash driver.

methods.name: Fls_GetJobResult
methods.description: Returns the result of the last flash job.

methods.name: Fls_MainFunction
methods.description: Main processing loop handling ongoing flash operations.
